items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Oh yeah, I remember Bruno, and I remember Candito and I met down there.

ctx.x: Do you have anything to say about those band in those days? Remember that band in Havana? And some of the guys we met? Remember Bruno?
Oh yeah, I remember Bruno, and I remember Candito and I met down there.
Candifo was a great trumpet player.
